summary: Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, as depositor, disclosed the September 30, 2026 issuance of BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-M1 Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates, Series 2026-M1, under a pooling and servicing agreement dated September 1, 2026. Public Classes A-2, A-3, X-A, A-S and B were sold to underwriters including Barclays, SGAS, BMO, GS, Citi, Academy and Drexel under a September 17, 2026 underwriting agreement; Private Classes C through R were sold to initial purchasers under a Section 4(a)(2) exemption. Midland serves as master servicer, CWCapital as special servicer, Computershare as trustee. This is a routine CMBS securitization closing, not a special situation; watch servicing transfers, appraisal reductions and any loan-level delinquency or modification disclosures.
